sample_unit: annotated time point in a grouped animal/session recording
output: continuous class scores; hard class IDs alone are insufficient
metric_policy: AUC only. Do not implement a guessed ROC/PR definition or add F1 as a second selected metric.
required_before_promotion: matching signal and machine-readable three-class annotations
first-party AUC definition, class order and aggregation
timestamps, recording/animal IDs and independent split grouping
source terms, bytes and hashes, isolated submission interface and representative real acceptance
data_substitution_forbidden: rendered supplementary videos used as guessed labels
